scope: Focused public issue, discussion, audit-note and pinned-source search; absence of an identical witness is not proof of first discovery.

source_locations.observation: One top_k=10 existing_results cohort supplies both extraction context and existing_hashes; current-batch hashes are separate and accepted facts receive new UUIDs.
Prompt suppression is a separate model-dependent defense; it does not transform a partial exact-hash set into a complete index.

strongest_antecedent: Discussion #6726 explicitly states the bounded candidate dependency; MiniMem independently states its semantic duplicate consequence.
remaining_question: Measure literal replay and derive its conditional capacity bound; no universal deduplication or exactly-once promise is inferred.

records.type: First-person public design discussion; not peer-reviewed evidence
records.summary: Identifies top-ten write-time candidate visibility as a limit on semantic recurrence recognition. Separately assumes exact repeats are caught by MD5; no literal N−k batch experiment was found in the inspected body.

records.type: Public issue with reported reproducer; not rerun in this audit
records.summary: Reports same-fact concurrent calls reading stale pre-insert hashes and inserting distinct UUIDs. This is a TOCTOU race, distinct from sequential candidate capacity.

records.type: Public issue with reported real-backend reproducer; not rerun here
records.summary: Reports expired records suppressing a fresh inferred write of the same fact while default reads hide the old record. It demonstrates why exact-content identity needs an explicit validity scope.
Maintainer distinguishes intentional ADD-only contradiction history from exact-text MD5 duplicate suppression. Neither means that inferred ingestion promises request exactly-once semantics.

records.type: Independent pinned-source audit; primary evidence of an antecedent analysis
records.summary: An August-dated audit distinguishes OSS from managed platform and lists ten retrieved records, exact hashing and batch UUID insertion. The inspected passage does not derive or test the literal batch-capacity bound.
